item.title: Collector
item.description: Function Overview link1. Device List link The device list can view online, faulty, offline and all device information. For collector devices, there are two additional states Installed: The collector is bound to a plant after entering the warehouse Not Installed: The collector is not bound to a plant after entering the warehouse 2. Collector entry link There are two ways to enter the collector Single import: import a single collector, import one collector at a time

item.title: Inverter
item.description: Function Overview link1. Device List link The device list can view online, faulty, offline and all device information. 2. Advanced device search link 3. Inverter details page link You can enter the device details page from the device in the device list The inverter details page displays inverter information and historical data charts 3.1 Alarm linkRefer to Collector Alarm 3.2 Unbinding linkRefer to Collector Unbinding, unbinding the sub-device will delete the sub-device from the collector and clear the sub-device data.
